standard: Regular attendance, compliance with leave procedures and consistent arrival before 7:30 AM.
Accurate and timely monthly test marks, term marks, reports, lesson plans, schemes of work and student records.
Subject knowledge, lesson preparation, syllabus coverage, student engagement and assessment practices.
Safe, organised and positive learning environment, effective routines and student discipline.
Creative, inclusive teaching methods, suitable technology and activities that improve learning.
Student wellbeing, fair treatment, safeguarding awareness and support for different learning needs.
Preparation and participation in assemblies, sports, exhibitions, concerts and other assigned events.
Initiative, practical ideas, improvement of systems and support for school projects and reputation.
Cooperation, respectful conduct, compliance with policies and constructive response to feedback.
Professional and timely communication with parents and responsible handling of concerns.
Reliability, ownership of tasks, following instructions and meeting deadlines.
Training, skill development, sharing good practice and readiness for additional responsibilities.
Evidence of student progress and contribution to positive parent relationships and school standards.
